title: Rapid protein stability prediction using deep learning representations (RaSP)
relevance: RaSP uses 3D CNN representations + downstream FCNN to predict Rosetta ddG values. Demonstrates rapid stability prediction as the mid-to-high fidelity tier of a cascading funnel.
key_finding: Self-supervised 3D CNN learns protein structure representations that enable rapid ddG prediction, achieving good correlation with Rosetta at orders of magnitude faster speed.

title: Venus-MAXWELL: Efficient Learning of Protein-Mutation Stability Landscapes using Protein Language Models
relevance: Demonstrates efficient learning of stability landscapes using PLMs, relevant to building fast surrogate scorers for the funnel pipeline.
key_finding: Efficient protein mutation stability landscape learning combining protein language model features.

title: Stability Oracle: a structure-based graph-transformer framework for identifying stabilizing mutations
relevance: SOTA structure-based stability predictor using graph-transformer. Could serve as an alternative mid-tier scorer in the cascading funnel.
key_finding: Graph-transformer achieves SOTA on identifying thermodynamically stabilizing mutations with innovations for data scarcity and computation time.

title: Structure-based self-supervised learning enables ultrafast protein stability prediction upon mutation (Pythia)
relevance: Pythia achieves 10^5-fold speedup over force-field methods with competitive accuracy. Excellent candidate for the fast-tier in a cascading funnel.
key_finding: Self-supervised GNN for zero-shot ddG predictions with 10^5-fold computational speedup, validated on limonene epoxide hydrolase.
